beats.title: Opening image
beats.description: A first picture of the protagonist's world, before the story changes it.

beats.title: Theme stated
beats.description: Someone says what the story is about, and the protagonist does not hear it yet.

beats.title: Setup
beats.description: The protagonist's life, the people in it, and what needs to change.

beats.title: Catalyst
beats.description: An event makes the old life impossible.

beats.title: Debate
beats.description: The protagonist hesitates before the risk of the journey.

beats.title: Break into two
beats.description: The protagonist chooses to act and enters a new world. Act two begins.

beats.title: B story
beats.description: A second story begins, often a relationship, and carries the theme.

beats.title: Fun and games
beats.description: The premise keeps its promise, with the scenes the audience came for.

beats.title: Midpoint
beats.description: A false victory or a false defeat raises the stakes.

beats.title: Bad guys close in
beats.description: Enemies regroup outside, and doubts grow inside.

beats.title: All is lost
beats.description: The lowest point. Something or someone is lost for good.

beats.title: Dark night of the soul
beats.description: The protagonist faces the loss, and finds the truth the theme held.

beats.title: Break into three
beats.description: The two stories meet and give the answer. Act three begins.

beats.title: Finale
beats.description: The protagonist applies what was learned, and settles the conflict.

beats.title: Final image
beats.description: A last picture that answers the first, and shows the change.
